scope: Visible mouth shape and garment color only; no emotional state or identity inference.

questions.name: visible_smile
questions.instructions: Does the main clearly visible person have visibly raised mouth corners and a clearly visible smile? Judge only mouth shape and visible expression; do not infer happiness, mood, personality, identity, or other non-visible traits. If the expression is subtle or uncertain, use low probability.

questions.name: neutral_gray_garment
questions.instructions: Does a large, clearly visible area of the main person's outer upper-body garment appear neutral gray? Exclude garments that appear blue, navy, black, or white. A small gray highlight is insufficient. If darkness or lighting makes gray versus blue or black uncertain, use low probability.
